prompt: A 1:1 Autumn 2026 city poster for Seattle with a quiet melancholic elegance and bold modern layout. On a misty slate-grey textured background with generous negative space, a miniature ferry cuts across the lower third of the frame on a ribbon of reflective Puget Sound water. The wake curls upward into a hand-painted ribbon containing iconic Seattle elements: Space Needle silhouetted in fog, Pike Place Market neon sign, layered evergreen hills, Pioneer Square brick facades, a Kingstreet station clock, floatplanes over Lake Union, and drifting rain clouds. Deep forest green, slate blue, and rust orange accents suggest changing leaves. Refined typography bottom-left reads "AUTUMN 2026" with a vertical slogan "SEATTLE, THE CITY BENEATH THE CLOUDS". Premium editorial design, subtle paper grain, text clear and beautifully composed
